title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Liqeni i Farkës, Tiranë (ID: 530181081-273)
description_sq:
Garsoniere me oborr / Liqeni i Farkes
Rezidenca 'Rose Garden Liqeni' eshte nje prej komplekseve me te reja me vila dhe apartamente qe po ndertohen buze liqenit te Farkes, nje nga zonat me te kerkuara ne Tirane.
'Rose Garden Liqeni' eshte e rrethuar nga gjelberimi unik i kodrave te Farkes dhe e pozicionuar direkt buze shetitores se liqenit.
Rezidenca eshte e perbere nga 25 vila, 28 apartamente si dhe me hapesira te vecanta sherbimesh e cila ofron shume lehtesira per banoret e rezidences.
Projekti eshte i konceptuar per te pasur impakt sa me te ulet ne mjedis, me shfrytezim minimal te tokes dhe duke respektuar normat me te fundit te efiçences energjitike.
Aksesi direkt ne shetitoren e liqenit te Farkes, e ben jetesen ne 'Rose Garden Liqeni' nje pervoje unike rrethuar nga natyra dhe ajri i paster.
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Farka Lake, Tirana (ID: 530181081-273)
description_en: Studio with courtyard / Farka Lake Residence 'Rose Garden Lake' is one of the newest complexes with villas and apartments that are being built on the edge of Farka Lake, one of the most sought after areas in Tirana. "Rose Garden Liqeni" is surrounded by the unique greenery of the hills of Farka and positioned directly on the edge of the promenade of the lake. The residence is made up of 25 villas, 28 apartments as well as special service areas which offer many facilities for the residents of the residence. The project is designed to have the lowest possible impact on the environment, with minimal land use and respecting the latest energy efficiency standards. The direct access to the promenade of the lake of Farka, makes the life in "Rose Garden Lake" a unique experience surrounded by nature and clean air.
